summary: WeShop Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing a board waiver of lock-in restrictions on shares held by Sidney PTC Limited, which holds approximately 21.3% of the company's Class A ordinary shares as trustee. The board, citing exceptional circumstances in the best interest of the company, resolved the waiver effective July 13, 2026, releasing 2,453,125 shares from the post-IPO 365-day lock-up, making them freely transferable subject to securities laws. Post-waiver, approximately 57% of Class A shares are no longer under lock-up restrictions. This is a post-IPO lock-up release, not a special situation event.
